result.document_summary: A mid-document slice of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 3, Article 3, Division 46) containing pedicab permit, decal, fare and operating regulations, with no residential rental provisions despite the source URL slug.
result.notes: This part contains only pedicab regulation provisions (Municipal Code sections 33.4602-33.4617). None of it concerns rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, application screening fees, screening restrictions or algorithmic rent setting. The 'application fees' in section 33.4603 are pedicab permit fees, not tenant screening fees. The URL slug refers to San Diego's algorithmic rent-price-fixing division (98.1103), but no such text appears in this part, so no rule is extracted.
